newsitem.title: USA: Family Golf acquires Leisure Complex.
newsitem.headline: Family Golf acquires Leisure Complex.

text.p: Family Golf Centers Inc said Thursday that it has acquired privately-held Leisure Complexes Inc for about $46 million in cash, stock and assumption of existing indebtedness.

In the transaction, Family Golf Centers said it acquired the Ponds Golf Center, and Sports Plus, a family entertainment complex, both located in Lake Grove, Long Island, New York, as well as Leisure Complexes' bowling division.
Family Golf Centers said that while it continues to consolidate stand-alone golf centers, it wanted an acquisition that would enable it to counter the seasonality of the golf business.
The transaction, said Family Golf, brings the total number of golf facilities it owns, operates, or is building, to 52 in 18 states.
